result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The requirements are subject to exceptions required by statute.
claims.quote: Except as otherwise required by statute

claims.claim: The summons must be directed to the defendant.
claims.quote: a summons shall be directed to the defendant

claims.claim: The clerk must sign the summons.
claims.quote: signed by the clerk

claims.claim: The summons must issue under the seal of the court where the action is pending.
claims.quote: issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending

claims.claim: The summons must contain the court title.
claims.quote: (1) The title of the court in which the action is pending.

claims.claim: The summons must name the parties.
claims.quote: (2) The names of the parties to the action.

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written pleading with the court in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint

claims.claim: The direction must specify a deadline of 30 days after service of the summons on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The summons must warn that if the defendant does not so respond, default will be entered upon the plaintiff's application.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff

claims.claim: The notice must say the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: and the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint

claims.claim: The notice must describe possible wage garnishment, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

claims.claim: The quoted statement about seeking and promptly consulting an attorney must appear in boldface.
claims.quote: (5) The following statement in boldface type:  “You may seek the advice of an attorney in any matter connected with the complaint or this summons. Such attorney should be consulted promptly so that your pleading may be filed or entered within the time required by this summons.”

claims.claim: The introductory legend must appear at the top, above all other matter.
claims.quote: (6) The following introductory legend at the top of the summons above all other matter

claims.claim: The legend must be in boldface and in both English and Spanish.
claims.quote: in boldface type, in English and Spanish:

claims.claim: The quoted introductory legend warns that the court may decide against the recipient without a hearing unless they respond within 30 days.
claims.quote: “Notice!  You have been sued.  The court may decide against you without your being heard unless you respond within 30 days.  Read information below.”

claims.claim: A county may by ordinance require the legend in an additional foreign language in every summons issued out of that county's courts.
claims.quote: (b) Each county may, by ordinance, require that the legend contained in paragraph (6) of subdivision (a) be set forth in every summons issued out of the courts of that county in any additional foreign language

claims.claim: The additional-language legend must use the same placement and boldface as the English and Spanish legend.
claims.quote: if the legend in the additional foreign language is set forth in the summons in the same manner as required in that paragraph.
claims.note: The referenced paragraph is (a)(6), which specifies placement and boldface.

claims.claim: A Judicial Council-approved summons form is deemed to comply with the section.
claims.quote: (c) A summons in a form approved by the Judicial Council is deemed to comply with this section.

claims.claim: SUM-100 is the Judicial Council summons form, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 displays the heading “NOTICE! You have been sued.”
claims.quote: NOTICE! You have been sued.

claims.claim: SUM-100 has a case-number field.
claims.quote: CASE NUMBER:

claims.claim: SUM-100 has a field for the court's name and address.
claims.quote: The name and address of the court is:

claims.claim: SUM-100 has a field for the name and address of the plaintiff or plaintiff's attorney.
claims.quote: The name, address, and telephone number of plaintiff's attorney, or plaintiff without an attorney, is:
claims.note: The field identifies the attorney when the plaintiff has one and the plaintiff when unrepresented.

result.summary: The statute supports the stated summons requirements within the ordinary civil-case scope. The supplied SUM-100 supports the revision date, notice wording, and fields described.
